name: v11 ordinary-hover heading gain trial
scope: RAM only. Restore the v11 baseline, verify all 112 parameters, and apply only the candidate below. Hold S1 centered during ordinary hover to observe entry readiness.
acceptance: Compare continuous 20 s neutral-stick hover windows at similar throttle. Look for lower measured yaw-rate RMS and longer ready windows, with no material increase in heading error or roll/pitch variability. A higher ready count by itself is insufficient.
